configurations.//: node.exe directly rather than npm: Node was installed mid-session, so it is not on the PATH this process inherited, and npm.cmd shells out to `node` by name.
configurations.//2: 5174, not 5173. The frozen build took 5173 because saves are IndexedDB and IndexedDB is per-origin, port included — see the comment on `preview` in vite.config.ts. Both servers can run at once on these ports.
configurations.name: playball

configurations.//: The frozen one, and the one to open on the phone. Serves whatever `npm run build` last put in dist/ and watches nothing, so a testing session is not interrupted every time a file is saved. Run the build again to move it forward.
configurations.//2: On 5173 so that a dynasty already played at http://<lan-ip>:5173 opens here. A different port is a different origin and a different IndexedDB, so the same save would be invisible.
configurations.name: playball-frozen
